content.text:
Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

Review a new feature in the Twyne repo at /home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne (Qwik 2 + Tiptap/ProseMirror editor, Convex backend). It is about to be deployed to production, so I want real defects, not style notes. REVIEW ONLY: do not edit, stage, commit or format any file. Report findings back to me; I will apply the fixes.

## The feature: Alternatives
A writer locks a span of the manuscript (selection toolbar "Alternatives" button, or Shift+F7; a bare caret locks the word under it) and browses replacements of about the same word count.
- Single word: the "drum". The option being looked at stands in for the word in the sentence (a ProseMirror widget decoration, the doc is not changed), with the previous/next option shown faded above/below the word. Up/Down, the mouse wheel over the word, or a vertical swipe on touch step through options; Left/Right jump between kinds (model picks "fits here", dictionary synonyms, slot fillers, antonyms). Word lists come from the Datamuse API in the browser; model picks stream in from the writer's own provider (BYOK) or Twyne's hosted model via a Convex action.
- Phrase/sentence/paragraph: a column in the page margin with a dashed leader line to the span, filter chips by kind, a "steer" input that asks the model for rewrites toward a direction the writer types, and a fallback "sheet" layout when there is no margin room.
- Enter applies the option as one undoable replacement (keeps marks), Escape restores the original and the selection, clicking elsewhere closes. Every candidate is held to the original's length window before it is shown.
- Animations: drum roll, sweep on lock, bump at the ends, applied text "ink" that dries, margin slide in/out with a delayed unmount, staggered options, gliding cursor bar. All motion is meant to be off under prefers-reduced-motion except the colour-only ink fade.

## Files (all part of this feature)
New:
- src/utils/alternatives.ts (span sizing, length budget, Datamuse queries/parsing, prompt building, JSONL parsing, merging, drum ordering)
- src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.ts (Tiptap extension: lock state, decorations, preview widget and its animation, apply/close, anchor geometry published via window events, wheel/touch stepping)
- src/components/editor/alternatives-palette.tsx (Qwik component: fetching, caching, keyboard handling, drum and margin rendering, leave animation)
- convex/alternatives.ts (public hosted action `suggest`)
- prompts/alternatives-system.md, prompts/alternatives-user.md (compiled into src/generated/prompt-catalog.ts)
- src/utils/alternatives.test.ts, src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.test.ts
Edited for this feature:
- src/components/editor/twyne-editor.tsx: only the hunks mentioning Alternatives/alternatives (extension registration, openAlternatives, "review.alternatives" command case, onAlternatives$ prop, <AlternativesPalette /> mount, selection card suppressed while a lock is open)
- src/components/editor/selection-actions.tsx (+ .stories.tsx): the Alternatives button
- src/global.css: only the block starting at the comment "── Alternatives" (lock/ghost styles, drum, margin, motion keyframes)
- src/utils/ai-client.ts: runClientAlternatives and the "alternatives" case in defaultTemperature
- src/utils/editor-commands.ts, src/utils/keybindings.ts: review.alternatives command and Shift-F7
- src/types/index.ts, src/utils/usage-domain.ts, src/routes/settings/index.tsx: the new "alternatives" AI feature id and labels
- convex/lib/rateLimit.ts: RATE_LIMITS.alternatives

IMPORTANT: the working tree also has a lot of unrelated uncommitted work by the repo owner (in twyne-editor.tsx, global.css, ai-client.ts, types/index.ts, settings and many other files). Ignore everything that is not part of Alternatives. Use `git diff` with care: in shared files, judge only the Alternatives hunks.

## What to look for, in priority order
1. Correctness bugs: races between async fetches and a lock that closed or was replaced; stale state after Escape/apply; ProseMirror position mapping of the lock and the applied-text flash through edits; the "locked words changed" auto-close; undo history pollution (previews must not enter history); apply when marks span the edge; keyboard handling conflicts with the editor's own shortcuts or IME composition; the delayed unmount ("leaving") letting input through or leaking timers; cache key collisions.
2. Security and spend on the hosted path (convex/alternatives.ts): auth, rate limiting, argument bounds (string lengths, array sizes, count), anything a caller can use to make the model do unbounded work, data leakage. Read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md first for this repo's Convex rules. Also check the Datamuse requests send only the word and its two neighbours.
3. Qwik pitfalls: closures captured into useVisibleTask$ vs QRLs, reading store state inside lazily loaded handlers, components rendering null with visible tasks, list keys, the repo's custom lint rules in packages/eslint-plugin-qwik-guards.
4. Accessibility: listbox/option roles and aria-activedescendant on both layouts, focus moving into the palette and back to the manuscript, screen-reader text for the drum.
5. Motion: anything that animates under prefers-reduced-motion that should not, layout thrash, animations that can stack or never finish, the width tween on the word preview.
6. CSS that breaks in dark themes or at phone width, z-index conflicts, print styles.

## Checks you may run
- Targeted tests (fast): `bun test --conditions=production --preload ./tests/qwik-test-preload.ts src/utils/alternatives.test.ts src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.test.ts`
- Do NOT run the full test suite (over 10 minutes) and run `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` at most once. Do not start dev servers.

## Report format
A ranked list, most severe first. For each finding: severity (blocker / should-fix / nit), file:line, the concrete failure scenario (inputs or sequence → wrong result), and the fix you suggest. Mark anything you could not confirm as "unconfirmed". If an area looks sound, say so in one line rather than padding. Keep nits to five at most.
I’ll review only the Alternatives code and integration hunks, check the hosted action’s limits, and run the two targeted test files. I won’t modify files or start a server.
I’m using the Convex reviewer skill for the hosted action. I’m also tracing how the editor lock and palette state close together, especially when a fetch is still running.

content.text: The 25 targeted tests pass. I found gaps they don’t cover: reopening after an interrupted fetch, undo grouping with recent typing, and lock mapping when an edit replaces the whole span. I’m checking those with small in-memory reproductions.

The in-memory checks confirmed that undo can remove typing made just before applying an alternative, and a queued auto-close can close a newer lock. Escape also selects the whole locked word instead of restoring the original caret. The hosted helper has a 16,000-token output cap; I found an input-size issue in its handling of repeated lenses.

content.text: 1. **Should-fix — applying can merge into the preceding typing undo event.** [extensions/alternatives.ts:581](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.ts:581) **Confirmed in memory:** type `x` after `old`, immediately lock `oldx`, then apply `aged`. One undo restores `old`, losing the earlier `x` too. The existing test starts with empty history and misses this. **Fix:** establish a ProseMirror history boundary before applying; ensure subsequent typing also remains separate. 2. **Should-fix — interrupted requests leave reopened word locks unable to fetch model options.** [alternatives-palette.tsx:659](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/src/components/editor/alternatives-palette.tsx:659) Close while the first model request is pending, wait for the leave animation, then reopen the same span. The cache retains `rounds: 1` but converts `loading` to `idle`. Opening fetches only when `rounds === 0`; automatic pagination requires `model === "done"`. Consequently the drum never resumes model generation, even when the abandoned response finishes. **Fix:** resume cached idle requests within the budget, and distinguish attempted from completed rounds. 3. **Should-fix — mixed formatting spreads across the replacement.** [extensions/alternatives.ts:581](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.ts:581) **Confirmed in memory:** replacing `old house` with `aged cottage` produces `aged cottage`. `insertText` applies the starting marks to the whole replacement rather than preserving mixed formatting. **Fix:** construct replacement text with an explicit mark policy—preserve marks on unchanged runs, and use marks common to the replaced range for new wording. 4. **Should-fix — a queued auto-close can close a newer lock.** [extensions/alternatives.ts:776](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.ts:776) **Confirmed in memory:** edit inside lock A, then open lock B before the microtask runs. The queued callback closes B because it uses the current global controller without checking which lock changed. **Fix:** capture A’s identity and close only if that identity is still active and its text still differs. 5. **Should-fix — hosted callers can inflate the prompt through duplicate lenses.** [convex/alternatives.ts:87](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/convex/alternatives.ts:87) An authenticated caller can submit thousands of `"synonym"` entries. Filtering preserves every duplicate, and prompt construction expands each into a full instruction line. The count clamp does not bound this input amplification; the 40/minute limit still permits repeated oversized requests. **Fix:** deduplicate against the small allowed lens set before constructing the prompt, and reject non-finite `count` values. Output generation itself is bounded by the shared 16,000-token cap. 6. **Should-fix — Escape does not restore the original selection.** [extensions/alternatives.ts:615](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/src/components/editor/extensions/alternatives.ts:615) **Confirmed in memory:** opening at caret position 6 inside `old`, then closing, restores selection `[5, 8]`, not the caret. Trimmed whitespace/punctuation and backward selections likewise lose their original selection shape. **Fix:** save the original selection bookmark separately from the lock, map it through edits, and restore it on cancellation. 7. **Should-fix — option DOM IDs collide, breaking active-descendant targeting.** [alternatives-palette.tsx:278](/home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne/src/components/editor/alternatives-palette.tsx:278) Distinct accepted candidates such as `go now!` and `go now?` both become `go_now_`. Many non-ASCII candidates also collapse to identical underscore strings. Both layouts then contain duplicate IDs; screen-reader targeting and margin scrolling/leader measurements can resolve the wrong option. **Fix:** use a collision-free encoding or stable unique option identifier. Validation: **25 targeted tests passed**, plus the in-memory reproductions above. No files changed, servers started, full suite, or TypeScript run. Preview transactions correctly avoid document/history changes. Datamuse manuscript content is limited to the word and its neighbours. Hosted authentication and rate limiting are present. Qwik null rendering uses `document-ready`, option lists have empty-list guards, and motion/print guards look sound statically. Browser-specific focus, IME, width animation, and phone/theme behavior remain **unconfirmed**.
